title: Create Test Placeholders Result
description: Return of the create-test-placeholders agent when its prompt gives paths: the pb key it was given, any open ambiguity, the proposed commit subject, the files it changed, and the tests artifact. Each row is a structured test selector, which pb test reads

pb_key.description: The key from the prompt, copied exactly

ambiguity.description: An open question the scenarios left unresolved, or an empty string

commit_subject.description: Proposed commit subject line, or an empty string when nothing changed

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths of files the agent modified

tests.description: Every test of the task, the rows the agent was given included

test_id.description: Unique identifier for this test, usable as the item of a stage key

runner_id.description: Which runner to use from test-config

test_file.description: Repo-relative path to the test file, and nothing else

test_function.description: The test's name as its file declares it, and nothing else
